ayahs.textArabic: قۤ  ۗوَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْمَجِيْدِ  ۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāf, wal-qur'ānil-majīd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Qaf. CONSIDER this sublime Qur’an!

ayahs.textArabic: بَلْ عَجِبُوْٓا اَنْ جَاۤءَهُمْ مُّنْذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا شَيْءٌ عَجِيْبٌ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Bal ‘ajibū an jā'ahum munżirum minhum faqālal-kāfirūna hāżā syai'un ‘ajīb(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: But nay - they deem it strange that a warner should have come unto them from their own midst; and so these deniers of the truth are saying, “A strange thing is this!

ayahs.textArabic: ءَاِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۚ ذٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيْدٌ
ayahs.textLatin: A'iżā mitnā wa kunnā turābā(n), żālika raj‘um ba‘īd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Why - [how could we be resurrected] after we have died and become mere dust? Such a return seems far-fetched indeed!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنْقُصُ الْاَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۚوَعِنْدَنَا كِتٰبٌ حَفِيْظٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qad ‘alimnā mā tanquṣul-arḍu minhum, wa ‘indanā kitābun ḥafīẓ(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Well do We know how the earth consumes their bodies, for with Us is a record unfailing.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاۤءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيْٓ اَمْرٍ مَّرِيْجٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Bal każżabū bil-ḥaqqi lammā jā'ahum fahum fī amrim marīj(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay, but they [who refuse to believe in resurrection] have been wont to give the lie to this truth whenever it was proffered to them; and so they are in a state of confusion.

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوْٓا اِلَى السَّمَاۤءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنٰهَا وَزَيَّنّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِنْ فُرُوْجٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Afalam yanẓurū ilas-samā'i fauqahum kaifa banaināhā wa zayyanāhā wa mā lahā min furūj(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Do they not look at the sky above them - how We have built it and made it beautiful and free of all faults?

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْاَرْضَ مَدَدْنٰهَا وَاَلْقَيْنَا فِيْهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَاَنْۢبَتْنَا فِيْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ بَهِيْجٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa alqainā fīhā rawāsiya wa ambatnā fīhā min kulli zaujim bahīj(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the earth - We have spread it wide, and set upon it mountains firm, and caused it to bring forth plants of all beauteous kinds,

ayahs.textArabic: تَبْصِرَةً وَّذِكْرٰى لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيْبٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Tabṣirataw wa żikrā likulli ‘abdim munīb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: thus offering an insight and a reminder unto every human being who willingly turns unto God.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مَاۤءً مُّبٰرَكًا فَاَنْۢبَتْنَا بِهٖ جَنّٰتٍ وَّحَبَّ الْحَصِيْدِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nazzalnā minas-samā'i mā'am mubārakan fa'ambatnā bihī jannātiw wa ḥabbal-ḥaṣīd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And We send down from the skies water rich in blessings, and cause thereby gardens to grow, and fields of grain,

ayahs.textArabic: وَالنَّخْلَ بٰسِقٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيْدٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wan-nakhla bāsiqātil lahā ṭal‘un naḍīd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and tall palm-trees with their thickly-clustered dates,

ayahs.textArabic: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِۙ وَاَحْيَيْنَا بِهٖ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًاۗ  كَذٰلِكَ الْخُرُوْجُ
ayahs.textLatin: Rizqal lil-‘ibād(i), wa aḥyainā bihī baldatam maitā(n), każālikal-khurūj(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: as sustenance appor­tioned to men; and by [all] this We bring dead land to life: [and] even so will be [man’s] coming-forth from death.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّاَصْحٰبُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُوْدُ
ayahs.textLatin: Każżabat qablahum qaumu nūḥiw wa aṣḥābur-rassi wa ṡamūd(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Long] before those [who now deny resur­rection] did Noah’s people give the lie to this truth, and [so did] the folk of Ar-Rass, and [the tribes of] Thamud

ayahs.textArabic: وَعَادٌ وَّفِرْعَوْنُ وَاِخْوَانُ لُوْطٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ‘āduw wa fir‘aunu wa ikhwānu lūṭ(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: and Ad, and Pharaoh, and Lot’s brethren,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَصْحٰبُ الْاَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۗ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيْدِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa aṣḥābul-aikati wa qaumu tubba‘(in), kullun każżabar-rusula faḥaqqa wa‘īd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and the dwellers of the wooded dales [of Madyan], and the people of Tubba: they all gave the lie to the apostles - and thereupon that whereof I had warned [them] came true.

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَعَيِيْنَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْاَوَّلِۗ بَلْ هُمْ فِيْ لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيْدٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Afa ‘ayīna bil-khalqil-awwal(i), bal hum fī labsim min khalqin jadīd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Could We, then, be [thought of as being] worn out by the first creation? Nay - but some people are [still] lost in doubt about [the possibility of] a new creation!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهٖ نَفْسُهٗ ۖوَنَحْنُ اَقْرَبُ اِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيْدِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad khalaqnal-insāna wa na‘lamu mā tuwaswisu bihī nafsuh(ū), wa naḥnu aqrabu ilaihi min ḥablil-warīd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: NOW, VERILY, it is We who have created man, and We know what his innermost self whispers within him: for We are closer to him than his neck-vein.

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيٰنِ عَنِ الْيَمِيْنِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيْدٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż yatalaqqal-mutalaqqiyāni ‘anil-yamīni wa ‘anisy-syimāli qa‘īd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And so,] whenever the two demands [of his nature] come face to face, contending from the right and from the left,

ayahs.textArabic: مَا يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ اِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيْبٌ عَتِيْدٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā yalfiẓu min qaulin illā ladaihi raqībun ‘atīd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: not even a word can he utter but there is a watcher with him, ever-present.

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَاۤءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ۗذٰلِكَ مَا كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيْدُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa jā'at sakratul-mauti bil-ḥaqq(i), żālika mā kunta minhu taḥīd(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [then,] the twilight of death brings with it the [full] truth that [very thing, O man,] from which thou wouldst always look away! –

ayahs.textArabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصُّوْرِۗ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيْدِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nufikha fiṣ-ṣūr(i), żālika yaumul-wa‘īd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [in the end] the trumpet [of resurrection] will be blown: that will be the Day of a warning fulfilled.

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَاۤءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَاۤىِٕقٌ وَّشَهِيْدٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa jā'at kullu nafsim ma‘ahā sā'iquw wa syahīd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And every human being will come forward with [his erstwhile] inner urges and [his] conscious mind,

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدْ كُنْتَ فِيْ غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنْكَ غِطَاۤءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيْدٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Laqad kunta fī gaflatim min hāżā fakasyafnā ‘anka giṭā'aka fabaṣarukal-yauma ḥadīd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and will be told:] “Indeed, unmindful hast thou been of this [Day of Judgment]; but now We have lifted from thee thy veil, and sharp is thy sight today!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ قَرِيْنُهٗ هٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيْدٌۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qāla qarīnuhū hāżā mā ladayya ‘atīd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And one part of him will say: “This it is that has been ever-present with me!”

ayahs.textArabic: اَلْقِيَا فِيْ جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيْدٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Alqiyā fī jahannama kulla kaffārin ‘anīd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Whereupon God will command:] “Cast, cast into hell every [such] stubborn enemy of the truth,

ayahs.textArabic: مَنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيْبٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Mannā‘il lil-khairi mu‘tadim murīb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [every] withholder of good [and] sinful aggressor [and] fomentor of distrust [between man and man – everyone]

ayahs.textArabic: ۨالَّذِيْ جَعَلَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَاَلْقِيٰهُ فِى الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِيْدِ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażī ja‘ala ma‘allāhi ilāhan ākhara fa'alqiyāhu fil-‘ażābisy-syadīd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: who has set up another deity beside God: cast him, then, cast him into suffering severe!”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَالَ قَرِيْنُهٗ رَبَّنَا مَآ اَطْغَيْتُهٗ وَلٰكِنْ كَانَ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍۢ بَعِيْدٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla qarīnuhū rabbanā mā aṭgaituhū wa lākin kāna fī ḍalālim ba‘īd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Man’s other self’ will say: “O our Sustainer! It was not I that led his conscious mind into evil [nay,] but it had gone far astray [of its own accord]!

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوْا لَدَيَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ اِلَيْكُمْ بِالْوَعِيْدِ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla lā takhtaṣimū ladayya wa qad qaddamtu ilaikum bil-wa‘īd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] He will say: “Contend not before Me, [O you sinners,] for I gave you a forewarning [of this Day of Reckoning].

ayahs.textArabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ اَنَا۠ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيْدِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā yubaddalul-qaulu ladayya wa mā ana biẓallāmil lil-‘abīd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: The judgment passed by Me shall not be altered; but never do I do the least wrong unto My creatures!”

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ نَقُوْلُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَـْٔتِ وَتَقُوْلُ هَلْ مِنْ مَّزِيْدٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma naqūlu lijahannama halimtala'ti wa taqūlu hal mim mazīd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: On that Day We will ask hell, “Art thou filled?”- and it will answer, “[Nay,] is there yet more [for me]?”

ayahs.textArabic: وَاُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ غَيْرَ بَعِيْدٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa uzlifatil-jannatu lil-muttaqīna gaira ba‘īd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [on that Day] paradise will be brought within the sight of the God-conscious, and will no longer be far away; [and they will be told:]

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَا مَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لِكُلِّ اَوَّابٍ حَفِيْظٍۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā mā tū‘adūna likulli awwābin ḥafīẓ(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: “This is what you were promised - [promised] unto every­one who was wont to turn unto God and to keep Him always in mind –

ayahs.textArabic: مَنْ خَشِيَ الرَّحْمٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَجَاۤءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيْبٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Man khasyiyar-raḥmāna bil-gaibi wa jā'a biqalbim munīb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [everyone] who stood in awe of the Most Gracious although He is beyond the reach of human perception, and who has come [unto Him] with a heart full of contrition.

ayahs.textArabic: ۨادْخُلُوْهَا بِسَلٰمٍ ۗذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُوْدِ
ayahs.textLatin: Udkhulūhā bisalām(in), żālika yaumul-khulūd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Enter this [paradise] in peace; this is the Day on which life abiding begins!”

ayahs.textArabic: لَهُمْ مَّا يَشَاۤءُوْنَ فِيْهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيْدٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Lahum mā yasyā'ūna fīhā wa ladainā mazīd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: In that [paradise] they shall have whatever they may desire - but there is yet more with Us.

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ اَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوْا فِى الْبِلَادِۗ هَلْ مِنْ مَّحِيْصٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum asyaddu minhum baṭsyan fanaqqabū fil-bilād(i), hal mim maḥīṣ(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND HOW MANY a generation have We destroyed before those [who now deny the truth] people of greater might than theirs; but [when Our chastise­ment befell them,] they became wanderers on the face of the earth, seeking no more than a place of refuge

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰى لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهٗ قَلْبٌ اَوْ اَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيْدٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna fī żālika lażikrā liman kāna lahū qalbun au alqas-sam‘a wa huwa syahīd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: In this, behold, there is indeed a reminder for everyone whose heart is wide-awake -that is, [every­one who] lends ear with a conscious mind -

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِيْ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍۖ وَّمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُّغُوْبٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad khalaqnas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa mā bainahumā fī sittati ayyām(in), wa mā massanā mil lugūb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [who knows that] We have indeed created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six aeons, and [that] no weariness could ever touch Us.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاصْبِرْ عَلٰى مَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوْعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوْبِ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Faṣbir ‘alā mā yaqūlūna wa sabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulū‘isy-syamsi wa qablal-gurūb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: HENCE, [O believer,] bear thou with patience what­ever they may say, and extol thy Sustainer’s limit­less glory and praise before the rising of the sun and before its setting;

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَاَدْبَارَ السُّجُوْدِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa minal-laili fasabbiḥhu wa adbāras-sujūd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and in the night, too, extol His glory, and at every prayer’s end.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِنْ مَّكَانٍ قَرِيْبٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wastami‘ yauma yunādil-munādi mim makānin qarīb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [always] listen for the day when He who issues the call [of death] shall call [thee] from close-by;

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُوْنَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ ۗذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوْجِ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma yasma‘ūnaṣ-ṣaiḥata bil-ḥaqq(i), żālika yaumul-khurūj(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and bethink thyself, too, of] the Day on which all [human beings] will in truth hear the final blast - that Day of [their] coming-forth [from death].

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيٖ وَنُمِيْتُ وَاِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيْرُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā naḥnu nuḥyī wa numītu wa ilainal-maṣīr(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, it is We who grant life and deal death; and with Us will be all journeys’ end

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْاَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۗذٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيْرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma tasyaqqaqul-arḍu ‘anhum sirā‘ā(n), żālika ḥasyrun ‘alainā yasīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: on the Day when the earth is riven asunder all around them as they hasten forth [towards God’s judgment]: that gathering will be easy for Us [to encompass].

ayahs.textArabic: نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَمَآ اَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍۗ فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ مَنْ يَّخَافُ وَعِيْدِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Naḥnu a‘lamu bimā yaqūlūna wa mā anta ‘alaihim bijabbār(in), fażakkir bil-qur'āni may yakhāfu wa‘īd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Fully aware are We of what they [who deny resurrection] do say; and thou canst by no means force them [to believe in it]. Yet none the less, remind, through this Qur’an, all such as may fear My warning.
